note: Curated candidate pool for FEAT-OSS-INVENTORY-DG (propagation wave). tier semantics live in wave.json; every entry is verified live by wave.py survey (metadata + recursive tree at the default branch). 'gaps' lists the GAP-DG-* anchors this repository is a candidate reference implementation for. The negative_control entry is fetched on purpose: its failure must appear in the registry (proving failures are recorded, not dropped).

repos.why: Numerically the most complete open DGSEM stack: entropy-conservative/stable split forms, subcell shock capturing, p4est-backed AMR and curved-mesh metrics in one tree.
Reference matrix-free DG operator evaluation plus geometric multigrid for the elliptic solve - the exact machinery GAP-DG-006 asks for.
Solver dedicated to hp-adaptation and dual-weighted-residual error estimation on DG/FR discretisations.
Engineering-scale DG compressible code on curved hexahedral meshes; the closest analogue of a production CFD DG solver.
Flux-reconstruction DG/FR with pluggable CPU/CUDA/HIP/OpenCL backends - the design template for GAP-DG-005.

Spectral/hp element framework with genuine simplex (tetrahedral) support and DG/SEM variants in one library. Upstream lives on GitLab (no GitHub mirror), so this wave records it without live metadata.
Long-lived massively parallel spectral-element solver; the scalability and turbulence-modelling reference for GAP-DG-005.
GPU-ported successor of Nek5000: shows how a high-order element operator is mapped onto accelerators without rewriting physics.

DUNE module with DG spaces, simplex grids and MPI; the second independent simplex-DG implementation for cross-checking orders of accuracy. Upstream lives on the DUNE GitLab, so this wave records it without live metadata.
hp-adaptive finite element library with DG spaces on simplex meshes, MPI and a Python front end; replaces the unavailable hp3d entry as the hp/simplex reference.
Library-grade high-order FEM/DG with simplex meshes, partial-assembly GPU kernels, AMR and a published subcell limiter example.
Benchmark of engineering quality for hp-adaptive finite elements including DG, simplex meshes, MPI and matrix-free operator loops.
DG used as a production method outside CFD (plasma/kinetic): independent evidence of which DG extras are load-bearing in practice.
The de-facto AMR forest-of-octrees library: 2:1 balance, hanging-node interfaces and partition-independent iteration numbers.
Block-structured AMR + GPU abstraction with conservative refluxing; the machinery a DG AMR needs around the element kernel.
Performance-portable AMR framework that already carries a DG (and FV) physics driver, i.e. a worked example of DG-on-AMR.
Matrix-free operator kernels for high-order elements including p-multigrid; the cheapest route to GAP-DG-006 preconditioning.
Newton-Krylov + multigrid stack (SNES/PC) that an implicit DG solver would delegate to instead of growing its own.
ARKODE IMEX/ARK integrators with embedded error control: the reference design for adding IMEX to an explicit-only DG stepper.
Modern MPI-parallel Python FEM with first-class DG spaces on simplex meshes; the interface idiom for GAP-DG-001 in a Python codebase.
FEM with integrated adjoint (pyadjoint) machinery, i.e. the plumbing behind dual-weighted-residual estimation.
Production FVM baseline: not a DG source, but the maturity/verification bar any DG result has to beat in engineering practice.
Deliberately unreachable: proves the census records fetch failures instead of silently dropping entries.
